gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clinical Study of a Novel Oncolytic Virus Ad-TD-nsIL12 in the Treatment of Primary High-grade Glioma
Glioma that meets the 2021 edition of the World Health Organization (WHO) classification criteria for central nervous system tumors and has not undergone any anti-tumor treatment

candidate_evidence.quote: Novel oncolytic virus Ad-TD-nsIL12: Ommaya capsule was placed for intratumoral injection at a dose of 1×10\^10vp

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioma that meets the 2021 edition of the World Health Organization (WHO) classification criteria for central nervous system tumors and has not undergone any anti-tumor treatment

role_evidence.quote: assessing the preliminary efficacy and safety of the novel oncolytic adenovirus Ad-TD-nsIL12 in treating primary HGG

agents.drug_class_hint: Ad-TD-nsIL12: oncolytic adenovirus expressing non-secreting IL-12, intratumoral via Ommaya
arms: Treatment of patients with non-functional areas, functional areas and primary HGG of the thalamus

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named anywhere in title, conditions, inclusion criteria or arm label; only primary high-grade glioma / glioma (WHO 2021), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Only intervention is an oncolytic virus (excluded type). Untreated primary HGG, neoadjuvant in one sub-trial, coded newly_diagnosed.
